died.name: Marcello d'Aste
died.last_words: I wish to die sitting, in tribute to the most worshipful will of my good and precious Jesus.

died.name: Robert E. Howard
died.desc: American author and creator of Conan the Barbarian
died.cause: his suicide note, a quotation from "The House of Cæsar" by Viola Garvin
died.last_words: All fled, all done, so lift me on the pyre. The feast is over, and the lamps expire.

died.name: Thích Quảng Đức

died.name: John Wayne
died.cause: to his daughter, Aissa Wayne, who had asked if he knew who she was
died.last_words: Of course I know who you are. You're my girl. I love you.

born.name: Joseph Warren
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Bunker Hill
born.last_words: I am a dead man: fight on, my brave fellows, for the salvation of your country.

born.name: Richard Strauss

born.last_words: I would give anything just to have written this.

born.name: Bartolomeo Vanzetti
born.last_words: I wish to forgive some people for what they are now doing to me.
